hypotheses.R1_full_order_expansion_recomposes_exact: For every target and row, summing all possible attention orders reproduces the exact state tangent with relative error at most 1e-4.
hypotheses.R2_full_order_expansion_recomposes_fishe: For every target and half, the complete cumulative expansion has response fidelity at least 0.999 and Fisher-geometry correlation at least 0.999.
hypotheses.R3_low_order_explosion_is_resolved_by_ca: For L0H0, order-6 fidelity is below zero while the complete expansion reaches at least 0.999 on both halves.
hypotheses.R4_earlier_target_needs_higher_attention: The first order reaching 0.90 fidelity is larger for L0H0 than L5H3 on both halves.
